brief: The canvas displays a dense, highly reflective cityscape undergoing continuous atmospheric cycles from day to night. The architecture is perpetually damp, catching and warping the changing light. Embedded within the rigid structures, bioluminescent plant life pulses softly, illuminating the scene with cyclical bursts of light. When these light pulses occur, they project distinct glows onto the wet stone and trigger visible, dissipating ripples that ripple outward across the reflective surfaces, creating a dynamic, ephemeral beauty.

statement: This sketch depicts a perpetually damp cityscape that transitions through atmospheric cycles from day to night without any external input. The architecture appears reflective and wet, with buildings rendered in dark stone that captures and warps light. Embedded within the rigid structures are bioluminescent plant life that pulse softly in rhythmic bursts. When these plants pulse, they generate distinct glowing ripples that emanate outward across the reflective surfaces of the city. The scene evolves continuously through time-based color shifts, rain animation, and pulsing bioluminescence—all without requiring user interaction. The visual effect demonstrates how natural elements like moisture and light can transform urban architecture into a dynamic, living environment.
